status: Pre-registered on 2026-11-08, committed before any count of this run existed. Seen beforehand: every v1 and v2 result at reset error 0, and v1's reset = readout variant (REPORT.md section 10, v1 score only). The decoder-graph score is v2's frozen score, unchanged. The devices are not new, so this tests the frozen score under a second noise setting, not on unseen hardware.

settings.zero: reset flip probability 0 on every qubit, as in the converted snapshots (IBM publishes no reset error)
settings.readout: each qubit's reset flip probability equals its readout flip probability (v1 T-L1, noise_aware_compilation.conditions.reset_equals_readout); IBM resets by measuring and flipping on outcome 1, so a wrong readout leaves the qubit in |1>

selection_rule: Every method selects under the noise model of the setting it is graded in. Qiskit's default transpile (levels 1-3) and mapomatic read the IBM-shaped Target of P1-5, whose reset carries the published readout error in the readout setting. mapomatic's default_cost charges every reset at the readout error in both settings, so its costs do not depend on the setting; its pick between a placement and its mirror (an exact tie in its cost) can, because the level-3 transpile it starts from reads the Target's reset error. Qiskit's default on the Target as IBM publishes it (reset without an error) is recorded as context.

precision_rule.description: As v1 and v2: shots per seed are doubled for every placement of the case together until each placement's pooled Wilson 95% half-width <= 10% of its P_L, or max_shots_per_seed is reached.

circuit_note: A, B, D5 and D7 are v2's circuits; A is the same circuit as v1's A3 (identical circuit hash). A1 and A5 are v1's 1- and 5-round d=3 circuits, which v2 did not run.
zero_setting_of_v2_cases: The reset = 0 counts of A, B, D5 and D7 are v2's committed runs (results_v2/runs), with the Phase 1 Step 6b choices (results_v3/reanalysis/baselines.json); they are not rerun.
verdict_rule: P1-1: better when the upper end of the 95% Newcombe interval for P_L(choice) - P_L(reference) is below zero, worse when its lower end is above zero, otherwise tie
test: two-sided pooled two-proportion z-test on the pooled failure counts; a comparison of a placement with itself has p = 1

reset-headline.description: decoder-graph score vs the fixed placement, lowest summed error, Qiskit's default transpile (level 1) and mapomatic, on v2's 10 cases with reset error = readout error; the same 40 comparisons as Phase 1's v2-headline family, in the other reset setting

exploratory: A1 and A5 on FakeHanoiV2 and FakeAlgiers at both settings: does the v1 score's T-L1 loss on Hanoi A1/A3/A5 replicate with fresh seeds, and does the decoder-graph score avoid it?
the v1 score, Qiskit's default at levels 2 and 3, v2's VF2Layout baseline and Qiskit's default on the published Target, against every reference
cross-fitted regret (P1-2) of every method in both settings
whether each method's choice changes between the settings

bootstrap.description: Unused (no drift in this run); present because nac_bench.analysis_v2.summarize reads it.
